title: UuidEntityMap
description: Standalone validation vehicle for PublicGame's UUID-keyed entity maps (see contracts/schemas/public-game.schema.json#/$defs/uuidEntityMap). Real production key types whose ToJSONKey is `deriving newtype` from the wrapped UUID (Arkham/Id.hs unless noted): EnemyId (enemies), AssetId (assets), TreacheryId (treacheries), EventId (events), SkillId (skills), ConcealedCardId (concealed), PlayerId (question), and CardId (cards, Arkham/Card/Id.hs). Entity value shapes remain an intentionally broad object placeholder -- out of scope for this map-key slice.
